elimination.campus_mole_cantina: Tacos are served in mole made with ground peanuts: violates Cyrus's peanut allergy (deal-breaker).
elimination.campus_taco_loft: Price tier $$, one over Maya's $ budget (costs a star); otherwise fits.
elimination.campus_burger_barn: Burgers only, 'don't come looking for tacos': misses the taco craving (costs a star).
elimination.campus_taco_town: Tacos, $, long tables pushed together for a study group, staff confirm no peanuts. Meets everything.

notes: Fair and solvable from the chat and reviews alone. Cyrus's summary line restates all four constraints, which makes the level very easy; fine for an early level. Each decoy fails exactly one constraint, and the peanut trap at Mole Cantina is only visible in its review, which is good use of the hidden-tag rule. Liam's 'crunchy ones' is not confirmed or contradicted by any review; nobody repeats it in the summary, so I treated it as flavour rather than a separate scored preference. If it is meant to be scored, no venue's reviews mention crunchy shells, which would be unfair.
